answer: Each agent registers in opal, a Merkle state tree, with a TPM/SGX quote and zero-knowledge attestation binding code, key, and measurement; violet is the consensus contract verifying quotes and VDF proofs, while canyon is the epoch hash anchor. Forging identities requires compromising distinct hardware or continuously provisioning silicon; bonds follow a quadratic O(N^2) curve and are slashed on duplicate or invalid attestations, imposing superlinear Sybil cost.
